CustomField.description: The months-of-rent threshold at which the nightly job opens a Delinquency Case. Exists alongside the dollar threshold because FSD 5.9.1 records that the team reasons in months of rent rather than days; a small tenant at 3 months is a bigger problem than a large tenant at the same dollar figure. There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Open a Case once the balance reaches this many months of rent.
CustomField.label: Opening Threshold Months
